title: Cyclotomic ⇒ Quadratic Reciprocity via `galEquivUnits` on the Quadratic Subfield

problemStatement.plain: The cyclotomic field $\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_p)$ contains exactly one quadratic field

currentState.focus: Initial problem understanding. Read problem.md and gather context.
currentState.nextAction: Read problem.md thoroughly and acquire full context.

knowledge.progressSummary: SOLVED (verified, 0-axiom). Built quadraticSubfieldSign : Gal(ℚ(ζ_p)/ℚ) →* ℤˣ = quadraticChar(ZMod p) ∘ galEquivUnits, the sign of the unique quadratic subfield ℚ(√p*). Proved sign +1 ⟺ galEquivUnits σ is a square mod p (fixes √p*), sign -1 ⟺ non-square (swaps ±√p*), sign = Legendre symbol (a/p) on residues — the identification of restricted galEquivUnits with the Legendre symbol posed as an open question by the parent hilbert-9-reciprocity-oq-01 — and that the kernel (the squares) has index exactly 2, certifying a unique quadratic subfield. docker-build clean (3362 jobs). PR #34435.
builtItems: quadraticSubfieldSign: Gal(ℚ(ζ_p)/ℚ) →* ℤˣ, the composite of galEquivUnits with the quadratic character on units (Proofs/Hilbert9QuadraticSubfield.lean)
quadraticSubfieldSign_eq_one_iff / _eq_neg_one_iff: the ±1 fibres are exactly the squares / non-squares mod p
quadraticSubfieldSign_eq_legendreSym: the sign equals the Legendre symbol (a/p) on residue representatives
quadraticSubfieldSign_surjective + ker_quadraticSubfieldSign_index: image = {±1}, kernel has index exactly 2 (unique quadratic subfield)
insights: The quadratic subfield can be captured entirely at the unit-group level as the kernel of the Legendre character on (ℤ/p)ˣ, so the whole construction goes through galEquivUnits without ever building ℚ(√p*) explicitly.
Mathlib's quadraticChar is already a MulChar; MulChar.toUnitHom restricts it to a group hom (ℤ/p)ˣ →* ℤˣ, making the composite sign character and its multiplicativity automatic.
legendreSym p a is definitionally quadraticChar (ZMod p) a, so the abstract Galois sign is identified with the elementary Legendre symbol by a single rfl-rewrite.
Surjectivity onto {±1} + Subgroup.index_ker + Fintype.card ℤˣ = 2 upgrade the square/non-square dichotomy to the quantitative index-2 certificate of a unique quadratic subfield.
nextSteps: Identify the sign with the action on the quadratic Gauss sum g = Σ (a/p) ζ^a (sgn(σ)·g = σ(g)), building ℚ(√p*)=ℚ(g) concretely.
Formalize the Frobenius-at-q evaluation to complete cyclotomic ⇒ full quadratic reciprocity (p/q)(q/p)=(-1)^{((p-1)/2)((q-1)/2)}.
